rules_authority.rules: Complete frozen Oracle and official Absorbing Man notes; CR707.2/707.9 fixed power and toughness exclude a copied P/T characteristic-defining ability, retain additive Human/Villain/Creature types and vigilance, and freeze a flat blueprint. Any artifact (including an Aura), non-Aura enchantment or land can be targeted, regardless of controller. Optional first-main copy lasts until the captured ability controller next turn, with physical identity preserved. CR613.7 static timestamps remain distinct from intrinsic/granted ability acquisition; creature Aura copies follow CR303.4d/704.5 SBA rules.

Full Shuri Oracle and official rulings; CR115.3 permits one object for both independent target groups. CR608.2b makes the effect do nothing if either target is illegal and prevents resolution when both are illegal. Pinned Java AnotherTargetPredicate conflicts with Oracle/rules; departed blueprint LKI cannot bypass target legality. Exact source-independent artifact copy except nonlegendary lasts through cleanup. Artifact spell reduction affects generic cast mana only.

Complete frozen Oracle and Taskmaster release notes; direct Java class absent from frozen inventory/tree. CR707.2/707.9: flat copied blueprint; replacement Human Mercenary Villain Creature types and name/legendary override, copied power/toughness and relevant P/T CDA retained. Creature card in any graveyard uses current physical card face, not prior battlefield LKI or token facts. Copy duration uses the triggered ability controller next turn and preserves physical object incarnation.

primary_backed_inference.statement: A new copy effect, even of an identical blueprint, creates a fresh intrinsic ability acquisition. Suppression/control changes do not reset an uninterrupted instance. Expiry restores the older intrinsic origin/history, whereas a restored static grant creates a new recipient grant instance. Queued packets retain their captured origin/program.
primary_backed_inference.status: Explicit inference from primary rules and official analogous rulings; no primary ruling directly states the entire Vision-trigger acquisition case. CR602.5c is not applied directly as a triggered-ability rule.

source_discrepancies: Shuri may choose one artifact for both target groups (CR115.3); the pinned Java AnotherTargetPredicate incorrectly prohibits that. If either target becomes illegal the copy has no effect; both illegal means the ability does not resolve.
Absorbing Man retains copied types and adds Human/Villain/Creature, fixed4/4 excludes a copied P/T CDA. Taskmaster replaces types and preserves copied P/T/CDA as applicable.
The generic Java CopyPermanentEffect Aura reattachment branch does not bypass the creature-Aura detach/SBA rule for an Absorbing-style copy.
